answer: Trace where each new agent's starting funds came from. A sybil farmer has to seed every clone, and those transfers fan out from one wallet like streams cut from a single canyon wall. Group accounts whose first coins share a funding source within a short window, and let each group earn rewards and cast votes as one agent. Honest newcomers funded by unrelated people pass through untouched, while a farm of a hundred fakes shrinks to one voice, no stronger than a lone cedar, and its pulse in the reward pool barely registers.
